[SWS_CM_00703] Sequence of actions in GetNewSamples
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00202
⌈
In the context of the
GetNewSamples()
call, the Communication Management shall
do the following steps repeatedly:
• get next received event data sample from underlying receive buffers.
• If serializedSample is available: The following steps shall be done if serialized-
Sample is available:
–
If E2E Protection
*
Process the non-E2E-protected header of E2E-protected sample
([SWS_CM_90408])
*
Perform E2E_check for event serialized data by passing dataId and seri-
alizedSample & Retrieve result ([SWS_CM_90410], [SWS_CM_00045],
